sections.heading: ISMS has every feature you will ever need to run your School efficiently.

p:
ISMS (Integrated School Management System) provides user-friendly dashboards with login access for teachers, non-teaching staff, students, parents and management personnel of your schools and institution. The various modules available in ISMS facilitate all the processes of your institution, from admission of new students to generating transfer certificates when students complete their studies.
ISMS is available in desktop and Web Version. It is very easy to use

ISMS manages Timetable, Attendance, Examinations, Gradebooks, Campus News, Library, Transportation, School Calendar, Events and many more. It has a fully-fledged Human Resource module to manage the payroll and employee pay slips. The Finance module helps you to plan and allot different fee structures to students. ISMS is is also an excellent collaboration tool using its Task, Discussion, Poll, Blog. There is an internal messaging system within ISMS but you can also integrate it with external communication tools like email and texting. To find out more, scroll through the following descriptions, Request for free demo or contact sales.

p.text:
ISMS gives you unparalleled access to your data for problem solving. It starts with a ‘worldview’ of your information, supports one-click drill down to detail, literally hundreds of ways to search for sets of records and easy output to reports, Excel, PDF, Doc, forms and email. ISMS can be integrated with SMS system. Using school master data, it can be published to school personal website for marketing and information purpose. For example, School educational team, Principle message, Chairman Message, holiday schedule, exam schedule etc.
Every school is unique, located in different regions and focused on different areas of expertise … one-size-fits-all is definitely NOT the case when it comes to school administration! ISMS supports multiple layers of personalization, from changing field labels, to setting up drop down data, to customizing reports and forms – even creating complex multi-variable attributes for students and prospects. all without programming help.
ISMS is a complete school administration application, so you can start at whatever level you need, and grow on your own schedule at your own pace – there are no additional modules to purchase and nothing new needs to be installed as you expand. From prospective student to alumni, from one specialization to many, from one campus to several – ISMS has you covered.
